from: จีนยุคกลาง

rule: ค่า's senses divide on one question: is the worth a sum of money or not. Sense 2, the price in money, takes every compound that names a sum actually handed over or demanded — the plain fees (ค่าเทอม, ค่าธรรมเนียม) and the whole vocabulary of money paid under pressure or in settlement (ค่าปิดปาก, ค่าคุ้มครอง, ค่าหัว, ค่าโง่, ค่าเสียหาย, ค่าน้ำนม, ค่าน้ำ), which is where the great bulk of this head's compounding goes. Sense 1, value at large, keeps only the worth that is NOT a sum: what a society holds worth (ค่านิยม) and being worthy of a thing (ควรค่า) — the part of its own gloss that says some value cannot be reckoned in money at all. Sense 3 is the mathematician's value of a variable and heads nothing here; sense 4 is the fixed phrase หาค่ามิได้ and heads nothing either.

notes.h2: 2026-09-22 — ค่า, หลัง, เนื้อ (38 filed, 1 spelling-variant) · the toponym note is repeating itself on the live pages
notes.text: Nine of eleven went to sense 2. That is what this head is for.

notes.h2: 2026-09-22 — ค่า, หลัง, เนื้อ (38 filed, 1 spelling-variant) · the toponym note is repeating itself on the live pages
notes.text:
**ค่าเสียหาย was the one I weighed.** Its gloss opens with มูลค่า, sense 1's own
word, not เงิน. I filed it at 2 because damages are a reckoned sum paid over, and
sense 2's gloss closes with เป็นต้น, which opens it past goods and services. The
ราชบัณฑิตยสภา coinage line in its etymology — *damages, damage, loss* — reads the
same way.

notes.h2: 2026-09-22 — ค่า, หลัง, เนื้อ (38 filed, 1 spelling-variant) · the toponym note is repeating itself on the live pages
notes.text:
**ค่าน้ำนม, filed 2, has a second gloss that reads at 1.** RID gives it two:
the support money the bride's side receives, and พระคุณของพ่อแม่, the debt owed to
parents who raised you. The money is first and the money is what I filed on; the
second gloss is the unpriceable worth of sense 1. One compound, two senses, and
the table holds one number.

notes.h2: 2026-09-22 — ค่า, หลัง, เนื้อ (38 filed, 1 spelling-variant) · the toponym note is repeating itself on the live pages
notes.text:
**ค่าคบ tagged `spelling-variant`.** ง่ามต้นไม้ที่กิ่งใหญ่กับลำต้นแยกกัน — the
fork where a big branch leaves the trunk. The word is **คาคบ**, which carries the
identical RID gloss in its own entry and is already queued under คา, whose sense 2
is ค้างอยู่, ติดอยู่ — lodged, stuck. Neither spelling has an etymology; the มายเอก
is the variation. ค่า 'value' plays no part in it.
**My uncertainty:** this gloss does not itself point at another spelling, which is
what the 9/18 sweep defined the tag by. The identical gloss under two spellings is
strong but it is my reading, not a source's. If the tag is meant to stay strictly
for *รูปสะกดผิดของ X* glosses, this one wants a sixth tag for homographs — a word
whose letters match this head but whose head is a different word.

notes.h2: 2026-09-22 — ค่า, หลัง, เนื้อ (38 filed, 1 spelling-variant) · the toponym note is repeating itself on the live pages
notes.text:
**ค่าที่ left unfiled.** คำสันธาน, glossed เพราะเหตุว่า — "because". No noun
reading survives and no sense of ค่า covers a conjunction. This is the ชื่อว่า case
from 9/18 with the covered reading removed: there, แม้ว่า was noted and the word
still filed at 1 because เรียกว่า was also a reading. Here there is nothing left to
file on, and I did not invent a grammaticalisation sense.
